settings.heading: The Case Your Resume Doesn't Make on Its Own
settings.content: A resume shows what you've done. A cover letter explains why it matters for this specific role — and why you're the one to hire. Many applications are still screened partly on the strength of the cover letter, especially for roles that involve communication, client work, or leadership. We write cover letters that read like a confident, specific pitch, not a restated resume.

settings.heading: Benefits of a Professionally Written Cover Letter
settings.text:
• Directly connects your background to the specific role and company you're applying to
  • Gives context a resume can't — career changes, gaps, or relocation, framed on your terms
  • Shows communication ability, which is itself a job requirement for most roles
  • Signals genuine interest over a generic, mass-sent application

settings.heading: How Every Cover Letter Is Structured
settings.subheading: A clear, four-part structure that stays specific instead of generic.

settings.title: Opening Hook
settings.text: A specific, confident opening line that names the role and your strongest relevant qualification — no "I am writing to apply for..."

settings.title: Proof of Fit
settings.text: Two to three concrete examples that connect your experience directly to the employer's stated needs.

settings.title: Why This Company
settings.text: A short, specific reason you're targeting this employer — not a generic paragraph that could apply anywhere.

settings.title: Confident Close
settings.text: A clear call to action inviting the next step, without sounding desperate or overly formal.

settings.heading: Cover Letters Are Formatted for ATS Too
settings.content: Many applicant tracking systems accept and store cover letters alongside resumes, and some parse their text for keyword relevance. We use clean formatting — no text boxes, columns, or graphics — and align language with your target job description, the same way we do for ATS resumes.

settings.heading: Questions About Our Cover Letter Service

settings.question: Is a cover letter included with the Professional Resume package?
settings.answer: No — cover letters are included starting with the Resume + Cover Letter package and above. You can also add cover letter writing separately by contacting us.

settings.question: Can I get a different cover letter for multiple job applications?
settings.answer: The Ultimate Career Transformation package includes a custom cover letter approach for multiple job targets. Other packages include one core cover letter template you can adapt per revision terms.

settings.question: How long is a typical cover letter?
settings.answer: Most cover letters we write are 250-350 words — long enough to make a real case, short enough that it actually gets read.

settings.heading: Pair Your Resume With a Cover Letter That Closes the Gap
settings.text: The Resume + Cover Letter package gives you both, ATS-optimized and ready to send.
